rule: Show one machine, one proof answer, one direct enquiry action.
purpose: Make marketplace decisions feel calm by turning trust, proof, availability, and payment guardrails into one buyer-facing card.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment collection. No rental commission. Supplier keeps rental payment direct. Heavyster earns listing SaaS revenue only.

buyer_card.primary_machine: Strongest visible listing after search and filters
buyer_card.proof_count: Visible ready proof checks over total proof checks
buyer_card.availability: Available now or confirm before enquiry
buyer_card.action: Copy proof card or open trust passport

gap_mode.when: No exact listing matches the buyer search
gap_mode.message: Capture demand and open supplier hunt before promising weak supply

acceptance: Marketplace renders Calm Proof Card below the buyer decision layer.
The card shows one selected listing instead of a long decision dashboard.
The copy action includes machine, supplier, category, trust, proof, availability, next action, and 0% rental take.
Gap mode converts missing supply into demand capture or supplier hunt.
Build Phase shows the v142 Calm Proof Card contract before the Release Ledger.
The UI remains calm, compact, and one-next-action oriented.
simplicity_rules: Do not add a new top-level navigation item for this release.
Keep proof visible before RFQ, award, booking, or AI automation.
Use soft status color only when it helps the buyer choose the next action.
Keep rental payment direct to the supplier in phase one.
